name: Killing Yourself
overview: Scripture clearly forbids taking one's own life, affirming the sanctity of life with the command, 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13). Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, honoring God with their lives (Romans 12:1), recognizing that they are God's workmanship created for good works (Ephesians 2:10). Instead of succumbing to despair or vengeance, Christians are reminded to trust God's justice, for vengeance belongs to the Lord (Romans 12:19), and that those who live in fear and unbelief face the second death (Revelation 21:8). Salvation is available to all who call upon the name of the Lord (Romans 10:13), offering hope beyond the struggles that may lead to thoughts of self-harm.
